prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in League City, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1297; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but I can confirm I'm the driver of the vehicle involved in the accident.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the accident happened and what you were doing at the time?

A: It was on a main road in League City, in the right lane, stopped at a traffic light. I was waiting for the light to change when I felt the impact from behind.

Q: What happened after the impact?

A: My car lurched forward and my hands were on the steering wheel. I braced myself and my right wrist hit the wheel hard. I knew right away something was wrong.

Q: Did you exit the vehicle or speak with the other driver?

A: I got out to check on things. The other driver said they looked down at their phone for a second and didn't see the light had turned green and I'd stopped. They seemed upset but apologized.

Q: Were there any police or emergency responders at the scene?

A: Yes, an officer came out and wrote up a report. An ambulance took me to the emergency room because my wrist was swelling badly and I couldn't move my fingers properly.

Q: What treatment have you received since the accident?

A: The ER took X-rays and told me I have a fracture in my wrist. They put me in a splint and referred me to an orthopedic doctor. I'm scheduled for follow-up appointments and I'm wearing a cast now. I've also had to take time off work because I can't grip or lift anything with that hand.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Just that I was following the rules of the road and I'm hoping this gets resolved quickly so I can get back to normal.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
